rules.description: Read the current design system contract before generating UI.
Reuse approved core components and their documented APIs.
Use semantic design tokens rather than introducing arbitrary visual values.
Do not introduce arbitrary colors or spacing; document justified exceptions.
Use the design system breakpoints and verify responsive behavior.
Preserve accessible names, semantic HTML, keyboard support and visible focus.
Reuse approved icons when available; no approved icon registry exists yet, so report this gap.
Search for an existing component before introducing a duplicate.
Validate the implementation against the contract and run applicable tests.
Report deviations, test evidence and unverified limitations explicitly.
